title: Healthcare ontology
description: Portable healthcare semantics imported from the Lattice industry ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: healthcare
  title: Healthcare Ontology
  description: Shared patient, provider, clinical, claims, diagnostic, payer, and authorization semantics.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: healthcare-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:7f02edc146b82cb4a9e6c0c36c9b5011db0b30d31d2e606e8fed52716e4e2fa4
spec:
  types:
    - id: patient
      label: Patient
      description: A person receiving governed healthcare services.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: patient.patient_dob
          label: Patient Dob
          description: Patient date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: patient.patient_name
          label: Patient Name
          description: Full name of the patient
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: patient.patient_member_id
          label: Patient Member Id
          description: Health plan member/subscriber ID number
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
        - id: patient.patient_mrn
          label: Patient Mrn
          description: Medical Record Number (MRN) assigned by the facility
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/3
        - id: patient.patient_responsibility
          label: Patient Responsibility
          description: Total amount patient owes (copay + coinsurance + deductible) as decimal
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/4
    - id: provider
      label: Provider
      description: A practitioner or organization delivering healthcare services.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: provider.provider_name
          label: Provider Name
          description: Full name of the clinician authoring the note (e.g., "Dr. Sarah Chen, MD")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: provider.provider_npi
          label: Provider Npi
          description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the authoring provider — 10-digit numeric; null if not
            embedded in note
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: provider.department
          label: Department
          description: Clinical department or unit (e.g., "Cardiology Outpatient Clinic", "Emergency Department",
            "2-North Med/Surg")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
        - id: provider.facility_name
          label: Facility Name
          description: Name of the hospital, clinic, or practice where the note was created
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/3
        - id: provider.ordering_provider_name
          label: Ordering Provider Name
          description: Full name of the clinician who ordered the tests
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/4
        - id: provider.ordering_provider_npi
          label: Ordering Provider Npi
          description: NPI of the ordering provider — 10-digit numeric; null if not printed on report
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/5
        - id: provider.pathologist_name
          label: Pathologist Name
          description: Name of the reviewing/verifying pathologist or laboratory director if signed on report. Null if
            not present
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/6
        - id: provider.provider_specialty
          label: Provider Specialty
          description: Clinical specialty or department of the provider (e.g., "Internal Medicine", "Emergency
            Medicine", "Orthopedics")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/7
        - id: provider.rendering_provider_npi
          label: Rendering Provider Npi
          description: NPI of the actual rendering/treating provider if different from billing provider
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/8
        - id: provider.requesting_provider_name
          label: Requesting Provider Name
          description: Requesting provider name
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/9
        - id: provider.requesting_provider_npi
          label: Requesting Provider Npi
          description: Requesting provider npi
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/10
        - id: provider.service_facility_name
          label: Service Facility Name
          description: Name of the facility where services were rendered (if different from billing provider)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/11
        - id: provider.service_facility_npi
          label: Service Facility Npi
          description: NPI of the service facility (CMS-1500 Box 32b)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/12
        - id: provider.servicing_provider_name
          label: Servicing Provider Name
          description: Servicing provider name
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/13
        - id: provider.servicing_provider_npi
          label: Servicing Provider Npi
          description: Servicing provider npi
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/14
    - id: clinical_encounter
      label: Clinical Encounter
      description: A governed episode of assessment, diagnosis, treatment, or follow-up.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: clinical_encounter.note_date
          label: Note Date
          description: Date the note was authored/signed, format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: clinical_encounter.diagnosis_codes
          label: Diagnosis Codes
          description: Array of ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes (e.g., ["I10", "E11.9"]). Extract all listed diagnosis pointers
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: clinical_encounter.bp
          label: Bp
          description: Blood pressure (e.g., "138/88 mmHg")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: clinical_encounter.chief_complaint
          label: Chief Complaint
          description: Patient's primary stated reason for visit in their own words or as paraphrased by provider. Free
            text, maximum 200 characters. Extract the most specific complaint from the "Chief Complaint" or
            "CC:" label
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: clinical_encounter.date_of_service_from
          label: Date Of Service From
          description: Start date of service, format YYYY-MM-DD (CMS-1500 Box 24A From)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
        - id: clinical_encounter.date_of_service_to
          label: Date Of Service To
          description: End date of service, format YYYY-MM-DD (CMS-1500 Box 24A To); same as from if single-day service
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/5
        - id: clinical_encounter.follow_up_instructions
          label: Follow Up Instructions
          description: Specific follow-up instruction text (e.g., "Return to clinic if fever > 101.5°F or worsening
            symptoms")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/6
        - id: clinical_encounter.follow_up_timeframe
          label: Follow Up Timeframe
          description: Time interval for scheduled follow-up (e.g., "2 weeks", "3 months", "as needed")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/7
        - id: clinical_encounter.hr
          label: Hr
          description: Heart rate (e.g., "76 bpm")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/8
        - id: clinical_encounter.icd10_code
          label: Icd10 Code
          description: ICD-10-CM code (e.g., "I10", "E11.9"). Null if only described without a code
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/9
        - id: clinical_encounter.medication_name
          label: Medication Name
          description: Medication name
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/10
        - id: clinical_encounter.note_type
          label: Note Type
          description: "Type of clinical note. One of: Progress | Discharge | Consultation | Admission"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/11
        - id: clinical_encounter.objective_vitals
          label: Objective Vitals
          description: "Structured object containing vital signs. Extract each of the following sub-fields as a string
            value (include units). Set to null if not documented:"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/12
        - id: clinical_encounter.place_of_service
          label: Place Of Service
          description: Place of service
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/13
        - id: clinical_encounter.rr
          label: Rr
          description: Respiratory rate (e.g., "16 breaths/min")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/14
        - id: clinical_encounter.service_description
          label: Service Description
          description: Service description
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/15
        - id: clinical_encounter.service_facility_name
          label: Service Facility Name
          description: Name of the facility where services were rendered (if different from billing provider)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/16
        - id: clinical_encounter.service_facility_npi
          label: Service Facility Npi
          description: NPI of the service facility (CMS-1500 Box 32b)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/17
        - id: clinical_encounter.spo2
          label: Spo2
          description: Oxygen saturation (e.g., "97% on room air")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/18
        - id: clinical_encounter.subjective_summary
          label: Subjective Summary
          description: Summary of the full Subjective section including history of present illness (HPI), review of
            systems, and relevant history. Free text, maximum 300 characters. Truncate with ellipsis if longer
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/19
        - id: clinical_encounter.temp
          label: Temp
          description: Temperature (e.g., "98.6°F" or "37.0°C")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/20
        - id: clinical_encounter.weight
          label: Weight
          description: Body weight (e.g., "185 lbs" or "83.9 kg")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/21
    - id: healthcare_claim
      label: Healthcare Claim
      description: A request for payment for healthcare services.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: healthcare_claim.billed_amount
          label: Billed Amount
          description: Total amount billed/charged by provider as decimal (CMS-1500 Box 28 or EOB "Billed" column total)
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: healthcare_claim.claim_number
          label: Claim Number
          description: Unique claim identifier assigned by payer (X12 835 CLM01 or payer-assigned reference number)
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: healthcare_claim.denial_reason_code
          label: Denial Reason Code
          description: ANSI X12 835 Group/Claim Adjustment Reason Code (CARC) if denied or adjusted (e.g., "96", "CO-4",
            "PR-1"). Null if claim was fully paid
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: healthcare_claim.allowed_amount
          label: Allowed Amount
          description: Payer-allowed/contracted amount as decimal (EOB "Allowed" or "Eligible" amount)
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
        - id: healthcare_claim.claim_status
          label: Claim Status
          description: "Adjudication outcome. One of: Paid | Denied | Pending | Adjusted"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/4
        - id: healthcare_claim.denial_reason_text
          label: Denial Reason Text
          description: Denial reason text
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/5
        - id: healthcare_claim.paid_amount
          label: Paid Amount
          description: Amount actually paid by payer to provider as decimal (X12 835 BPR02 or EOB "Plan Paid" amount)
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/6
        - id: healthcare_claim.patient_responsibility
          label: Patient Responsibility
          description: Total amount patient owes (copay + coinsurance + deductible) as decimal
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/7
        - id: healthcare_claim.remark_codes
          label: Remark Codes
          description: Array of Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARC) associated with the claim (e.g., ["N130",
            "MA01"]). Null or empty array if none
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/8
    - id: care_authorization
      label: Care Authorization
      description: A governed request and decision permitting healthcare services.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: care_authorization.authorization_id
          label: Authorization Id
          description: Authorization id
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: care_authorization.appeal_deadline
          label: Appeal Deadline
          description: Appeal deadline
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: care_authorization.clinical_criteria_referenced
          label: Clinical Criteria Referenced
          description: Clinical criteria referenced
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: care_authorization.decision_date
          label: Decision Date
          description: Decision date
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: care_authorization.expiration_date
          label: Expiration Date
          description: Expiration date
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: care_authorization.request_date
          label: Request Date
          description: Request date
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
        - id: care_authorization.request_status
          label: Request Status
          description: Requested | Approved | Denied | Pending | Partially_Approved | Expired
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/6
        - id: care_authorization.units_approved
          label: Units Approved
          description: Units approved
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/7
        - id: care_authorization.units_requested
          label: Units Requested
          description: Units requested
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/8
    - id: diagnostic_result
      label: Diagnostic Result
      description: A laboratory or diagnostic observation with reference and status context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: diagnostic_result.clinical_notes
          label: Clinical Notes
          description: Free-text comments, interpretation notes, or footnotes appended to the report by the laboratory.
            Maximum 400 characters. Null if none
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: diagnostic_result.collection_date
          label: Collection Date
          description: Date the specimen was collected from the patient, format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: diagnostic_result.critical_values_present
          label: Critical Values Present
          description: Boolean — true if ANY result in this report has a Critical (C) flag or is labeled "Critical
            Value" or "Panic Value" in the report
          dataType: boolean
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: diagnostic_result.loinc_code
          label: Loinc Code
          description: LOINC code if printed on report (e.g., "718-7"); null if not present
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: diagnostic_result.received_date
          label: Received Date
          description: Date the specimen was received by the laboratory, format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
        - id: diagnostic_result.reference_range
          label: Reference Range
          description: Normal reference range as a string (e.g., "13.5-17.5", "<100", "Negative"). Null if not provided
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/5
        - id: diagnostic_result.report_date
          label: Report Date
          description: Date the laboratory report was finalized/issued, format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/6
        - id: diagnostic_result.result_value
          label: Result Value
          description: The result value as a string (e.g., "14.2", ">1000", "POSITIVE", "RESISTANT")
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/7
        - id: diagnostic_result.specimen_type
          label: Specimen Type
          description: "Type of biological specimen tested. One of: Blood | Urine | Swab | CSF | Stool | Sputum | Tissue
            | Pleural_Fluid | Serum | Plasma | Other"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/8
        - id: diagnostic_result.test_name
          label: Test Name
          description: Name of the test as printed on the report (e.g., "Hemoglobin", "Glucose", "Creatinine")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/9
        - id: diagnostic_result.test_results
          label: Test Results
          description: "Array of individual test result objects. For each test result line, extract:"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/10
    - id: payer
      label: Payer
      description: An organization or plan responsible for healthcare coverage.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: payer.payer_name
          label: Payer Name
          description: Name of the insurance company or health plan paying the claim
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: payer.group_number
          label: Group Number
          description: Patient's insurance group number
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1
        - id: payer.payer_id
          label: Payer Id
          description: Payer's electronic ID or NAIC code
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
        - id: payer.plan_name
          label: Plan Name
          description: Plan name
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/3
        - id: payer.plan_summary
          label: Plan Summary
          description: Summary of the Plan section including medications prescribed/adjusted, orders placed, referrals,
            and instructions. Free text, maximum 300 characters. Truncate with ellipsis if longer
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/4
    - id: person
      label: Person
      description: A human being identified in a governed business context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the person.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2
    - id: organization
      label: Organization
      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the organization.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name
          label: Legal name
          description: Registered or otherwise authoritative organization name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: organization.organization_type
          label: Organization type
          description: Governed classification of the organization.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: agent
      label: Agent
      description: A human or software actor authorized to perform governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: agent.agent_id
          label: Agent identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the actor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: agent.agent_type
          label: Agent type
          description: Whether the actor is human, service, or automated.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/1
        - id: agent.active
          label: Active
          description: Whether the agent is currently authorized.
          dataType: boolean
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/2
    - id: location
      label: Location
      description: A physical, administrative, or virtual place relevant to governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10
      properties:
        - id: location.location_id
          label: Location identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the location.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name
          description: Human-readable location name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code
          label: Country code
          description: ISO country code when applicable.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/2
    - id: document
      label: Document
      description: A governed information artifact with identity, version, and provenance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11
      properties:
        - id: document.document_id
          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: document.title
          label: Title
          description: Authoritative document title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: document.version
          label: Version
          description: Document version or revision.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at
          label: Issued at
          description: Time at which the document was issued.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/3
    - id: event
      label: Event
      description: A governed occurrence bounded by time and business meaning.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12
      properties:
        - id: event.event_id
          label: Event identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/0
        - id: event.event_type
          label: Event type
          description: Governed classification of the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/1
        - id: event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred at
          description: Time at which the event occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
